MetaDataVersion.Name: Study CDISCPILOT01, Data Definitions
MetaDataVersion.def:ComputationMethod: Total scores of "ALZHEIMER'S DISEASE ASSESSMENT SCALE" and "NEUROPSYCHIATRIC INVENTORY - REVISED (NPI-X)" were derived as described in the SAP. For all other Test codes: LBSTRESN= LBSTRESC converted to numeric
(date portion of --DTC) minus (date portion of RFSTDTC) , add 1 if -- DTC >= RFSTDC
